episodes.title: He's in Refrigerators
episodes.summary: In near-future Kyoto, Suzie grapples with extreme grief and receives a domestic robot to help her through.

episodes.title: Don't Blame the Machine
episodes.summary: As she tries to figure Sunny out, Suzie unearths memories of her husband Masa.

episodes.title: Mmmm, Hinoki
episodes.summary: Suzie, Sunny, and Mixxy make a discovery. Noriko pressures Suzie to have a proper funeral for Masa.

episodes.title: Sticky
episodes.summary: The Yakuza make themselves known. Suzie searches for the truth about Masa's lineage.

episodes.title: Joey Sakamoto
episodes.summary: Sunny and Suzie flee Kyoto with Mixxy to take refuge at her family's farm.

episodes.title: Kyoto Manju, So Delicious
episodes.summary: Suzie officially meets Himé and her friends. Noriko learns to master the game of shogi.

episodes.title: There's Been a Shift
episodes.summary: Mixxy is sucker-punched by the realities of her friendship with Suzie. Himé confronts Jin.

episodes.title: Trash or Not-Trash
episodes.summary: In the past, Masa slowly emerges from hikikomori.

episodes.title: The Dark Manual
episodes.summary: Season finale. After learning the truth, Suzie fights for what matters most.
